description: AOS AONR21357 — 30 V P-channel MOSFET in 3.0 × 3.0 mm DFN-8 with exposed drain thermal pad. Rated 34 A continuous, 12.3 mΩ at VGS = −4.5 V, 30 W, and ±25 V gate-source.
name: aonr21357

provenance.source: EasyEDA import from LCSC C431196; symbol/footprint contact set and exposed pad 9 reviewed against the package data. Ratings reviewed from the LCSC product page and attached AOS datasheet.

watch_out_for: Pins 1/2/3 are source; pin 4 is gate; pins 5/6/7/8 and exposed pad 9 are drain. For a 10 A path, connect every parallel drain pad and pad 9 to the load copper/thermal-via region. Drive the gate within the ±25 V VGS absolute maximum; the 15 V high-side circuit requires its 10 V source-gate clamp.
